pages.title: Neural Organoid
pages.text: A pea-sized brain grown in a dish: real neurons, folded and connected, with no body around them. Its electrical activity has started to look like the patterns of a sleeping brain. I try not to think about what it might be dreaming about.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Brain organoids are a real technology. I grew stem cells around a thought matrix with a room-temperature superconductor for wiring and fed them synaptic fluid. Within days the electrodes recorded coordinated waves.
